## English
- Separate saved tasks from automatic schedules, and add editable task names and schedule source labels.
- Use Escape to close the focused thread or preview and stop selected message cards.
- Choose a default responder when adding a channel.
- Improve the clerk conversation queue and allow deletion of message cards that have not started.
- Align notification icons and text, and update the public documentation.
